'''Meltwater Outpost''' was a military outpost of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that was part of the [[Belsavis prison]], the Republic detention complex built on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. Meltwater Outpost was located in the western reaches of the [[High Security Section]], along the southern wall of the region known as the [[Gran Exile]].<ref name="TOR" />
